items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was in the band too. I forget who else was in it. Maybe J.G., Johnny Griffin. We went on the road a couple of weeks with that band.

ctx.x: He was in the band too. I forget who else was in it. Maybe J.G., Johnny Griffin. We went on the road a couple of weeks with that band. I snuck out and made a few bucks when I wasn’t supposed to leave New York under this stupid regulation.

Before we get into the MJQ stuff and the Dizzy stuff, I wanna talk about… there are so many records you made on the Prestige and Blue Note labels with people like Art Farmer, Miles Davis. Talk about recording, because you were kind of like the house bass player for those early sessions. Talk about what it was like playing, and also I want to ask you specifically about this one session, Miles Davis Jazz Giants were supposedly Monk and Miles were fighting and you were on that gig. I wanna set the record straight on…
